title: Customer-reported experiences and uncertain workshop issues
summary: This topic is dominated by incomplete or uncertain customer-reported statements, with the clearer examples spanning general satisfaction, app and control usability, intermittent issues, and workshop-related concerns.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention loving the car, satisfaction with the BMW app, and becoming comfortable with the digital controls.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe intermittent problems and a phone-related tray issue, but the sampled examples do not provide enough detail to identify a single concrete failure pattern.

mixed.summary: The mixed review says the customer needed time to adapt to the digital controls but ultimately was not bothered by the lack of physical buttons.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews are largely fragmentary customer or workshop statements that hint at technology, heating, drivability, and repair concerns without enough context to assign clear sentiment consistently.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined or incomplete, which limits confident interpretation of the underlying issue or experience.
The examples mix unrelated subjects such as app satisfaction, digital control adaptation, intermittent issues, workshop time, heating behavior, and drivability impressions.
Negative examples are too sparse and underspecified to summarize a precise common complaint.
Samples are stratified and not representative estimates of the full population of G60 reviews.
